title: Botany genetics M2: chemical mutation through tray metabolism
acceptance_criteria: Source-backed weighted tables preserve 111 actual canonical routes, source grouping/duplicates, and inclusive source boundaries.
Effective per-instance inherited Inherent/default chemistry is persisted and transmitted, and the actual resolved Vestine descriptor is consumed through the normal tray poll.
Unknown mutation tables or table reagent references fail closed before any effects or source drain.
Chemical source fixedpoint matches signed-epsilon Min/Max/contribution cent arithmetic without an arbitrary 10000 codec cap.
Absent and dead-plant guards hold; generated produce receives acquired chemistry through real registered harvest, extraction, and replant paths.
Fixture labels pending/mutated real source chemistry, and examine presents the read-only effective profile.
Baseline botany regressions pass. This M2 gate does not claim complete 27-mutation runtime, full 71-entry catalog, pollen, or owner acceptance.
manual_steps: Run `/ms14 botany_fixture`; wait about 3 seconds; run `/ms14 botany_fixture status` and find the chemical-mutation label and acquired IDs. Harvest, extract, and replant through ordinary play.
